critical_unknown_policy: For any key listed as blocking a stage in the rule registry, UNKNOWN or absent blocks that stage; it never means unrestricted.

posting_exactness.disclosure_requirements: posting_recommendation.disclosure exactly mirrors required/text/instructions/placement; VIDEO/BOTH also require edit/render/QC proof; PROVIDER_SUBMISSION mirrors provider_disclosure
posting_exactness.submission_format: posting_recommendation.submission_requirements exact normalized requirements; deadline_at is the sealed campaign deadline mirror

duration_rule: effective maximum = minimum of every KNOWN applicable campaign clip_length_max_seconds and source_rights.platform_limits.<platform>.max_clip_seconds; effective minimum = KNOWN campaign clip_length_min_seconds. UNKNOWN critical duration/restriction blocks edit/render/QC rather than implying infinity.
authority: HONOR_CAMPAIGN_RULE_REGISTRY.json; immutable rule rows for exact campaign_terms_snapshots.id

posting_snapshot_requirements.required_tags: posting_recommendation.required_tags contains every KNOWN required tag
posting_snapshot_requirements.required_hashtags: posting_recommendation.hashtags contains every KNOWN required hashtag
posting_snapshot_requirements.disclosure_requirements: posting_recommendation.disclosure exactly mirrors KNOWN rule value; UNKNOWN blocks recommendation
posting_snapshot_requirements.submission_format: posting_recommendation.submission_requirements mirrors KNOWN rule value; UNKNOWN blocks recommendation/submission
posting_snapshot_requirements.source_attribution: independent source-rights required_attribution must appear in posting_recommendation.source_attribution and caption

future_recommendation_revalidation: GET /v1/schedule/tomorrow and any owner-facing authorized posting recommendation must re-check honor_current_rights_for_action at response time; clips whose stored rights_id is no longer the latest authorized PUBLICATION_RECOMMENDATION version are omitted/blocked, while historical clip provenance remains unchanged.
sealed_rule_set_requirement: Every allocation/edit/audio/clip recommendation/render/post/submission/finance consumer must resolve a campaign_rule_set_commits row for every referenced campaign rule snapshot, with committed_at <= its DB-authoritative decision/action time.

render_audio_exactness.render_safe_audio_PROHIBITED: No render-safe MUSIC/SFX unless that exact class subrule is explicitly ALLOWED; UNKNOWN class permission never grants use.
render_audio_exactness.music_allowed_PROHIBITED_OR_UNKNOWN: music_asset_id MUST be null and render manifest contains no MUSIC asset.
render_audio_exactness.sfx_allowed_PROHIBITED_OR_UNKNOWN: sfx_events MUST be empty and density MUST be NONE.
render_audio_exactness.max_sfx_density: effective audio plan density may not exceed NONE<LOW<MEDIUM<HIGH; NONE means no SFX; null while SFX is ALLOWED blocks planning.
render_audio_exactness.instructions: Exact instructions are copied to audio_plan.rule_compliance and must be acknowledged when operationally material; render/QC verify exact planned assets.
render_audio_exactness.outer_NOT_APPLICABLE: Campaign adds no render-audio restriction; HONOR defaults may plan active render-safe assets. rule_compliance must bind the exact snapshot with all inner rule states NOT_APPLICABLE, null max density, empty instructions, and exact actual asset/density/event mirrors.
render_audio_exactness.class_NOT_APPLICABLE: When outer rule is KNOWN and a class subrule is NOT_APPLICABLE, the class inherits render_safe_audio: ALLOWED master permits it; PROHIBITED/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE master does not. For SFX, null max_sfx_density means no campaign density cap only in this inherited NOT_APPLICABLE case.

disclosure_placement.CAPTION: posting disclosure placement=CAPTION and required disclosure text/instruction is present in owner caption copy.
disclosure_placement.VIDEO: edit_plan.disclosure_render + render_manifest.campaign_disclosure + QC disclosure_video must prove rendered disclosure; caption alone is insufficient.
disclosure_placement.BOTH: CAPTION and VIDEO requirements both apply.

submission_deadline_source: V1 uses the sealed deadline_at campaign rule as posting_recommendation.submission_requirements.deadline_at unless a future approved schema adds a distinct submission-deadline rule. KNOWN must equal exactly; NOT_APPLICABLE -> null; UNKNOWN blocks recommendation/submission.
